W.note: 5-7-5 (Lens cloud on the ridge=5; the whole gale runs through its shape=7; ice cracks underfoot=5); lenticular cloud is accurate and the stillness-in-wind idea is good, but the ice line is disconnected and 'rare' is only implied.

X.note: 5-7-5 (Mother-of-pearl sky=5; nacreous clouds hold the sun=7; long after it sets=5); names nacreous clouds and their real after-sunset glow, with a clean turn in the last line, though 'mother-of-pearl' is a stock descriptor.

Y.note: 6-7-5 (Pearl-lit mother-of-pearl=6; nacreous clouds blaze at dusk=7; ice dreams in the dark=5), so line one is long; 'pearl-lit mother-of-pearl' is redundant and 'ice dreams' is vague.

Z.note: 5-7-5 (Winter dusk, sun gone=5; mother-of-pearl on thin cloud=7; the lake ice holds it=5); the lake ice reflecting nacreous colour is a fresh, seen image, though the cloud is evoked rather than named.
